sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select process,item,reason,owner from attention_queue order by process,item

sections.title: Improvement work
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due,state from actions order by due

sections.title: Observed paths
sections.sql: select process,path,cases,closed_cases,mean_closed_hours from variant_summary order by process,cases desc
sections.note: Only cases explicitly marked closed contribute to completed-case duration averages.

sections.title: Elapsed gaps
sections.sql: select process,previous_activity,activity,measured_gaps,mean_gap_hours,max_gap_hours,overlapping_events from transition_summary order by max_gap_hours desc nulls last
sections.note: Gaps are elapsed calendar hours between adjacent events with known end times. They are not measured idle labour or business hours.

sections.title: Checkpoint findings
sections.sql: select process,case_code,checkpoint,finding from checkpoint_findings order by process,case_code

sections.title: Privacy evidence reminders
sections.sql: select process,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by process,rule
sections.note: Record checks support review of purpose, accuracy and retention. They do not certify legal compliance.
